deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
Developer and agent coverage for onboarded protocols
request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe, described as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,684,050 ADA total, consisting of 1,635,000 ADA for the Open API Layer for Cardano Protocols and a 49,050 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The underlying vendor work is described as 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months.
Tx3 is intended to let developers and AI agents discover, integrate, and compose Cardano protocols through a single consistent interface surface.
The proposal states that Tx3 produces documentation, auto-generated multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from verified protocol interface definitions.
The proposal states that Catalyst Fund 14 has already put the Tx3 developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal claims there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol from scratch.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

The proposal states that independent oversight and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect, technically capable third parties, and the Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for Tx3 by TxPipe, routed through Intersect treasury management contracts, to expand a protocol interface registry and add agent-facing infrastructure over 12 months.
